Rep. Jason Crow criticizes Trump’s handling of Iran conflict and economic impact
Rep. Jason Crow, a U.S. Congressman representing Colorado’s 6th district since 2019, has used his social media platform to criticize former President Donald Trump’s foreign and domestic policies in a series of posts published on August 18 and 19, 2026.
On August 18, Crow commented on the ongoing conflict involving the United States and Iran, writing, "We are now in week 24 of Trump’s '2 to 3 week' war with Iran."
The following day, he addressed economic concerns linked to U.S. military actions abroad, stating, "Americans aren’t just paying more for everything. They’re having to do it with less. That’s the cost of Trump’s endless wars abroad."
Later on August 19, Crow referenced a statement attributed to Donald Trump regarding rising gas prices: "‘When you have to pay a little bit more for gas, you're at $4, it's okay. I'll never apologize.’ —Donald Trump"
Crow has served as the representative for Colorado's 6th District since replacing Mike Coffman in 2019. Born in Madison, Wisconsin in 1979 and currently residing in Aurora, Crow holds a BA from the University of Wisconsin–Madison and a JD from the University of Denver.
